Why this sign matters

Warns workers about a minor burn from hot condensate piping at the reboiler condensate return so they take simple precautions; minor or moderate injury only.

Where to post it

Mount on the support at hand height nearest the condensate line in the distillation area.

Who orders it

Chemical plant EHS managers, distillation unit operators, maintenance supervisors.
